candidates.name: Butterfly Cut
candidates.description: Long hair with pronounced face-framing layers and a shorter-looking upper outline.
candidates.evaluation_route: Existing Hair adapters: isolated prompt comparison; choose adapter by observed quality.
candidates.visual_acceptance: Must show a distinct face-framing layer structure rather than reproducing generic layers.

pilot_review.observation: Neither adapter produced the requested long Butterfly shape on the reused short-bob input. Test an appropriate input before deciding on retraining.

candidates.name: Wolf Cut
candidates.description: A choppy crown with a longer back and a distinctly shaggy outline.
candidates.evaluation_route: Existing Hair adapters: isolated prompt comparison.
candidates.visual_acceptance: Must distinguish crown and back length from the existing shag while preserving the face.

candidates.name: Korean Two-Block
candidates.description: A longer upper section visibly separated from shorter sides and nape.
candidates.evaluation_route: Existing Hair adapters: isolated prompt comparison.
candidates.visual_acceptance: The short lower section and fuller upper section must be visible; a centre part alone is insufficient.

pilot_review.observation: TRAIN-001 changes are weak; TRAIN-002 changes the fringe but does not clearly show a shorter lower block.

candidates.name: Korean Comma Hair
candidates.description: A styled front section curved inward into a comma-shaped fringe.
candidates.evaluation_route: Existing Hair adapters: isolated prompt comparison.
candidates.visual_acceptance: The fringe curve must be visible, without changing forehead or facial geometry.

pilot_review.observation: TRAIN-002 gives the clearest curved front strand; curl/fringe fidelity and preservation still require varied-input and stylist review.

candidates.name: Textured French Bob with Wispy Bangs
candidates.description: A short textured bob with a soft, separated fringe.
candidates.evaluation_route: Existing Hair adapters: isolated prompt comparison.
candidates.visual_acceptance: Texture and wispy bangs must be visible compared with the existing bob.

candidates.name: Cloud-Skin Makeup with Blurred Berry Lips
candidates.description: A soft base with diffused berry lip edges and restrained cheek color.
candidates.evaluation_route: Existing MAKEUP-001 adapter: private custom-prompt experiment; keep frozen production preset file intact.
candidates.visual_acceptance: Berry color and softened lip edges should be visible without smoothing away identity or changing mouth shape.

pilot_review.observation: Berry pigment visible; edges defined rather than blurred, strong cheek pigment and substantial complexion lightening/smoothing.

candidates.name: Manga-Lash Makeup
candidates.description: Separated lash clusters with delicate liner, soft blush, and a restrained lip.
candidates.evaluation_route: Existing MAKEUP-001 adapter: private custom-prompt experiment.
candidates.visual_acceptance: Distinct separated lash clusters; no enlarged eyes, altered eyelids, or artificial lashes drawn across skin.

candidates.name: Icy Silver Eye Makeup
candidates.description: Localized silver-blue eyelid shimmer balanced with subdued cheeks and lips.
candidates.evaluation_route: Existing MAKEUP-001 adapter: private custom-prompt experiment.
candidates.visual_acceptance: Clearly cool-toned eyelid makeup; preserve eye geometry and keep pigment in plausible makeup regions.

pilot_review.observation: Cool metallic eyelid effect visible; vivid red lip and strong complexion retouching exceed the requested edit.

candidates.name: Raspberry Jelly
candidates.description: A translucent raspberry tint that retains visible nail detail.
candidates.evaluation_route: Isolated renderer transparency experiment; not an existing supported renderer style.
candidates.visual_acceptance: Must appear translucent rather than opaque red or pink; preserve surrounding skin and source nail outline.

pilot_review.observation: Translucent tint direction visible on one manual-mask hand; zero outside-mask pixel edits verified.

candidates.name: Pink Aura Ombré
candidates.description: A concentrated pink center fading softly into a lighter surrounding base.
candidates.visual_acceptance: A central glow rather than the existing tip-directed gradient; no polish outside reviewed nail masks.

pilot_review.observation: Central gradient visible and distinct from tip ombre; automatic masking and varied hands remain unverified.

candidates.name: Negative-Space Micro-Dots
candidates.description: Sparse fine dots over a sheer base with visible uncovered nail.
candidates.evaluation_route: Isolated renderer pattern experiment using per-nail coordinates.
candidates.visual_acceptance: Dots remain small, separated and inside each nail without accidental skin/jewelry dots.

pilot_review.observation: Small separated dots visible within supplied masks; automatic masking and varied hands remain unverified.

candidates.name: Milky Pearl Chrome
candidates.description: A pale base with a subtle pearlescent reflective overlay.
candidates.evaluation_route: New finish rendering or localized model experiment; feasibility unresolved.
candidates.visual_acceptance: A visible pearl finish distinct from plain gloss; no claim of physically accurate moving reflections.

candidates.name: Dark-Red Velvet Cat-Eye
candidates.description: A deep red base with a narrow reflective band and a soft luminous finish.
candidates.evaluation_route: New finish rendering or localized model experiment; feasibility unresolved.
candidates.visual_acceptance: A clear reflective band distinct from red gloss; a still image cannot demonstrate view-dependent movement.
